questions.prompt: Which form are we filling out today: Social Security's Adult Disability Starter Kit, Maine's Developmental Services Intake Application, or both?
questions.hint: The Starter Kit helps you get ready to apply for Social Security disability benefits. The Developmental Services application is how adults with an intellectual disability or autism apply to Maine for services. Say starter kit, developmental services, or both.

questions.prompt: What is your name, or the name of your agency?

questions.prompt: What is your mailing address? Just the street or post office box for now.
What town or city is that in?

What is the zip code?
What is your phone number?

phrases.ALL_DONE: All done. Your forms are ready to download.
phrases.ANSWER_AGAIN: Go ahead. Say your answer again, or type it instead.
phrases.BOTH_DOWNLOADED: Both forms have been downloaded. Check your downloads folder. If your browser asked whether to allow more than one download, choose allow, or download the second form with its own button.
phrases.DOWNLOADED: Your form has been downloaded. Check your downloads folder.
phrases.DOWNLOAD_HINT: Press a download button to save your filled form, or press read my answers to hear everything back.

ERRORS.empty: I did not hear anything. Please try again, or say skip.
ERRORS.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try that answer again.

phrases.FILL_IN_MISSING: Let us fill in what is missing.
phrases.FORMS_CHANGED: Your choice of forms changed, so there are new questions to answer. Let us do those now.
phrases.HELP: You can say: repeat that, go back, skip this, where am I, read back my answers, change an answer, remove an entry, save and quit, or start over.

INTRO.text: Typing mode. I will ask a question, you type the answer and press Enter. The hold to talk button is still there whenever you would rather speak. You can type skip, back, or repeat at any time.
INTRO.handsfree: Hands free mode. I will ask a question, then start listening on my own. Just answer when you hear the tone. When I read an answer back, tap the space bar to keep it, or press N to answer again. You can type an answer instead at any point, and speaking still works afterwards. Say repeat, go back, or skip at any time.
INTRO.voice: Voice mode. Hold the space bar while you answer, and let go when you are done. When I read an answer back, tap the space bar to keep it, or press N to answer again. You can type an answer instead at any point, and speaking still works afterwards. Say repeat, go back, or skip at any time.

REASK.generic: I did not catch that. Could you say it again?
REASK.yesno: Please answer yes or no. Is that correct?
REASK.nothingHeard: I did not hear anything. Please try again, or say skip.
REASK.notRight: That does not look right. Could you try again?
REASK.yesnoTranscript: Please say yes to keep that, or no to answer again.
REASK.unsure: I am not sure I heard that correctly. Could you say it again?

phrases.SAVED: Saved. You can close this page and come back to finish later.
phrases.TRANSCRIPT_CHECK: Is that right? Say yes to keep it, or no to answer again.
phrases.TYPING_LANE: Typing. Press Escape when you want the space bar to talk again.
phrases.VOICE_LANE: Voice. Hold the space bar to talk, or press T to type.
phrases.WHICH_FIELD: Which answer would you like to change? You can name the field, for example, my phone number, or the second provider's address. You can add a new entry, by saying something like add another condition, or remove a whole entry, by saying remove that last provider. Say never mind to go back.
phrases.WORKSHEET_FALLBACK: The official form could not be loaded, so I saved a plain worksheet with your answers instead.
